classes.name: Weapon Master

skills.name: Call to Elements
skills.description: Grants a Boon depending on location
skills.effects: grants a different Boon depending on your current location. For locations with no associated boon, Rage will be granted by default.

skills.name: Mana Push
skills.effects: Push a powerful gust of wind forward with short range * Deals 1 physical damage * Deals 100 impact

skills.name: Reveal Soul

skills.effects: Reveals the Soul Spots (blue orbs, see below) on fallen human enemies, and corpses. You may also find orbs on certain grave stones, as well as random skeleton corpses that cannot be interacted with. Casting a secondary spell near these blue orbs produces combination effects.

skills.name: Weather Tolerance
skills.description: +8 Hot weather def; +8 Cold weather def; +5 decay resistance

skills.name: Jinx
skills.description: Inflicts a random Hex debuff on the target.
skills.effects: = * Will randomly inflict one of: Chill, Curse, Doom, Haunted or Scorched (equal random chance) on the target enemy * The spell can only be blocked by terrain and walls, it cannot be blocked or resisted by characters.

skills.name: Nightmares
skills.description: Reduces Max Mana burn from sleeping by 25%; Reduces Max Stamina burn recovery by 25%
skills.effects: = * Reduces the rate at which max Mana is burnt when Resting by 25% * Reduces the rate at which burnt Stamina is recovered when Resting by 25%

skills.name: Torment
skills.description: Triggers a related reaction in all nearby enemies afflicted with a Hex
skills.effects: = Triggers a related reaction for every Hex inflicted on all nearby Enemies: * Chill: 25 Frost damage, inflicts Slow Down * Curse: 20 Decay damage, inflicts Poisoned * Doomed: 20 Lightning damage, inflicts Weaken * Haunted: 20 Ethereal damage, inflicts Sapped * Scorched: 20 Fire damage, inflicts Burning * Pain: 10 Ethereal damage, inflicts Bleeding * Confusion: 0 damage, 50 Impact, re-applies Confusion

skills.effects: * Reduces Equipment movement penalties by 50%. ** Importantly, this only applies to the attributes "Movement Speed" and "Stamina Use" on equipment. It does not apply to general weight burdens from wearing too much heavy equipment.

skills.name: Mana Ward
skills.description: Force Bubble
skills.effects: *The caster is granted the Force Bubble status for the duration of the effect. *While this spell protects the user from most damage, it does not prevent Impact, meaning you can still be staggered or knocked down during the effect.

skills.name: Sigil of Fire
skills.description: Creates a Sigil of Fire, enabling spell combos.
skills.effects: * Raises the player's Temperature Stage by 3 (heats the player up). In neutral temperature environments this increases the player's temperature delta by +28 .

skills.name: Haunting Beat
skills.description: Deploys Ghost Drums on the ground, and causes Haunted in a small radius.
skills.effects: = * Deploy the Ghost Drum * Cannot be placed within 30 meters of another totem, unless you have Harmony and Melody * Continuously deals Haunted to enemies inside the ring. * You can strike the instrument once every 3 seconds to send out blasts. * Picking up the Ghost Drum will reset the charges to 0. If an enemy is in range, hitting the Drums with a weapon will: * Add a charge to the instrument when a blast hits an enemy, increasing the instrument's power. * Send out a blast dealing 10 Ethereal damage to nearby targets, and an additional 3 damage per charge on the instrument with a maximum of 40 base damage. The blast also inflicts Aetherbomb on enemies. **The Aetherbomb buildup starts at 20% and increases by an additional 6% per charge, with a cap of 100% at 14 charges. **The Drum's damage is affected by equipment and boons of the player who placed the drum at the time the projectile hits the enemy.

skills.name: Miasmic Tolerance
skills.description: Increase Status Effect resistance by 15% when well rested.
skills.effects: = * When you have a Sleep Effect you gain 15% Status Resistance.

skills.name: Welkin Ring
skills.description: Deploys the Sky Chimes and causes Doom in a small radius.
skills.effects: = * Deploy the Sky Chimes * Cannot be placed within 30 meters of another totem, unless you have Harmony and Melody * Continuously deals Doomed to enemies inside the ring. * You can strike the instrument once every 3 seconds to send out blasts. * Picking up the Sky Chimes will reset the charges to 0. If an enemy is in range, hitting the Chimes with a weapon will: * Add a charge to the instrument when a blast hits an enemy, increasing the instrument's power. * Send out a blast dealing 10 Lightning damage to nearby targets, and an additional 3 damage per charge on the instrument with a maximum of 40 base damage. The blast also inflicts Holy Blaze on enemies who are afflicted with Burning. **The Holy Blaze buildup starts at 20% and increases by an additional 6% per charge, with a cap of 100% at 14 charges. **The Chimes' damage is affected by equipment and boons of the player who placed the drum at the time the projectile hits the enemy.

skills.name: Backstab
skills.description: Dagger attack
skills.effects: *If the skill hits the enemy's back, it will deal quadruple damage and impact (4.0x). *If the skill does not strike the enemy in the back, it does the same damage as Dagger Slash. *The extra damage If the skill hits the enemy's back is processed as separate hit, which also triggers any Status Effects on the dagger again. This makes it possible to inflict statuses with one cast of Backstab.

skills.name: Opportunist Stab
skills.description: Inflicts Dagger damage
skills.effects: * Deals the damage from the player's equipped Dagger. * If the enemy has Pain or Confusion, Damage and Impact are 3.0x times stronger * If the enemy has Pain and Confusion, Damage and Impact are 6.0x times stronger * This skill will remove Pain and Confusion hexes from the enemy if they have them * Effects from the Dagger are inflicted on hit

skills.name: Pressure Plate Training
skills.description: Can deploy Pressure Plate Trap

skills.name: Sweep Kick
skills.description: High impact against Confused targets; Area of Effect Radius
skills.effects: * A stronger version of Push Kick, dealing 20 physical and 85 Impact * If the target has Confusion, they will receive 99999 Impact, which is a guaranteed knockdown unless they have 100% Impact resist * Hits all targets in a small area-of-effect radius

skills.name: Acrobatics
skills.description: Unhampered Dodge Rolls have increased range. Stamina cost of Dodge Rolls increased by 50%
skills.effects: = * Unhampered Dodge Rolls have increased range (hampered rolls are when you have a backpack that restricts your dodge) * Stamina cost of Dodge Rolls increased by 50% (from 6 to 9)

skills.name: Brains
skills.description: Increases Elemental Damage by 15%, but lowers physical damage by 25% and increases Stamina costs by 15%
skills.effects: = * Increases Elemental damage dealt by 15% * Reduces Physical damage dealt by 25% * Increases Stamina cost of actions by 15%

skills.name: Brawns
skills.description: Increase Physical Damage by 25% and increase max stamina by 25, but lowers elemental damage by 40%.
skills.effects: = * Increases Physical damage dealt by 25% * Increases max Stamina by 25 * Reduces Elemental damage dealt by 40%

skills.name: Cruelty
skills.description: Increases the damage of DoTs, but reduces Status Resistance and Physical resistance
skills.effects: = * Increases damage by 50% for: Burning, Poisoned and Extreme Poison * Increases damage by 30% for: Bleeding, Extreme Bleeding, Blood Leech Victim, Blaze, Holy Blaze and Plague. * Lowers Status Resistance by 50% and Physical resistance by 10%.

skills.name: Patience
skills.description: Increases damage of Weapon Skills by 30%. Lowers damage of normal and special weapon attacks by 20%.
skills.effects: = * Increases damage of Main-Weapon Skills by 30%. This also includes Gong Strike, Shield Charge, Elemental Discharge, Bow skills and Dagger skills, as well as Push Kick, Sweep Kick and Frost Kick. * Reduces damage of normal and special attacks on weapons by 20%. ** It also reduces damage from combination attacks such as Standard > Special. ** It does not reduce damage from running attacks.

skills.name: Unsealed
skills.description: * In the Vanilla game (NOT Definitive Edition), the skill is bugged and does not extend Sigil durations. Category:Pages which list bugs
skills.effects: = * Increases the speed at which you places Sigils, and extends their duration by 20 seconds. * Lowers your max Health by 25.

skills.description: Maximum Stamina increased by 25.

skills.description: {{description|Passive skill that increases Corruption resistance by 10%.}}

skills.name: Probe
skills.description: A weak attack that increases Alertness level on hit.; Evolves into stronger forms as Alertness level rises.

skills.name: Brace
skills.description: Blocks attack. If successful:
skills.effects: Blocks an attack (can be melee, magic or ranged). If successful: * Restores Stability * Nearby enemies are knocked back, and the attacker's Stability is reduced to 50% The effects of Brace only apply if an attack was successfully countered. If no attack was blocked, Brace goes on cooldown and no effects are gained.

skills.name: Focus
skills.description: Grants Discipline

skills.name: Slow Metabolism
skills.description: Slower Hunger, Drink, Sleep decay
skills.effects: The values with which this skill affects your stats are: * Drink deplete rate: -20% * Sleep deplete rate: -20% * Food deplete rate: -15%

skills.name: Crescendo
skills.description: Quick attack which grants Craze on successful hits.
skills.effects: = * Quick attack, dealing 1.0x Damage and Impact. * Successful hits grant a stack of Craze.

skills.name: Dispersion
skills.description: Create an AoE shockwave which destabilizes yourself. Effect varies depending on Imbue.
skills.effects: = Create an AoE shockwave on the ground. * Deals 2.0x weapon Damage and 1.5x weapon Impact * Reduces your Stability to 0, but does not stagger you. If you have a Melee Imbue on the weapon, the effects will vary: * Fire imbues: Damage overrides to Fire, inflicts Scorched. * Frost imbues: Damage overrides to Frost, inflicts Chill. * Lightning and Light imbues: Damage overrides to Lightning, inflicts Doomed. * Ethereal and Wind imbues: Damage overrides to Ethereal, inflicts Haunted. * Decay and Poison imbues: Damage overrides to Decay, inflicts Curse.

skills.name: Moment of Truth
skills.description: High damage strike which ignores 50% of enemy resistances, player receives Drawback.
skills.effects: = * High damage strike which deals 3.5x Damage and 0.5x Impact. * The attack ignores 50% of the enemy's Damage Resistance (not Protection or Barrier). Examples: An enemy with 30% damage resistances would take damage as if they have 15% damage resistances, and an enemy with 95% damage resistance would take damage as if they had 47.5% damage resistances. Additionally, if the resistance is below 0%, then the effect is deactivated. ** Note: Resistance modifiers (such as Pain) are applied before the halving effect of .

skills.name: Scalp Collector
skills.description: Inflicts Bleeding on hit. Kills with this attack grant Kill Streak.
skills.effects: = * Strike with the axe, dealing 1.2x Damage and 0.1x Impact * Kills with this attack grant Kill Streak

skills.name: Splitter
skills.description: Leaping strike that grants short immunity and increases in power as the enemy's life % decreases.
skills.effects: = * Leaping strike, granting immunity during the animation. * Impact is multiplied by 1.5x regardless of enemy Health. * Damage is multiplied by up to 6.0x depending on target enemy's Health %. For example, if enemy is at 100% health it deals 1.0x damage, and at 0% health it would deal 6.0x Damage if the target wasn't already dead. * If your weapon is imbued, grants +15 bonus damage of the element of the imbue. * Burns 5 Stamina and 5 Health

skills.name: Strafing Run
skills.description: Shoot the bow 5 times rapidly, while strafing left or right.
skills.effects: = * As the description states, simply run to the left or right while rapidly shooting 5 shots from your Bow.

skills.name: The Technique
skills.description: Unleash a flurry of 6 rapid strikes. Burns 10 Stamina.
skills.effects: = * Rapidly strike 6 times with the sword, dealing 0.8x Damage and 0.25x Impact per hit * Burns 10 Stamina (in addition to the natural Stamina burn from the 30 stamina cost of activation)

skills.name: Vicious Cycle
skills.description: High impact strike, inflicts Crippled and Slow Down.
skills.effects: = * High impact strike dealing 2.0x Damage and 3.0x Impact

skills.name: Vital Crash
skills.description: Long distance tackle, dealing more damage and impact the more health and stamina you have. Inflicts Pain and Confusion on the player.
skills.effects: = * A long-distance running tackle. * Damage multiplied by 0.03x, and then multiplied by your Character's current Health. For example at 100 health it would be 3.0x Damage. At 200 Health, it would be 6.0x damage. This is not %-based as the description indicates, but a direct multiplier from your current health. * Impact uses the same multiplier as Damage, but based on your current Stamina. *Player receives 100% buildup for both Pain and Confusion. *The player won't get the statuses from this ability alone if they have any amount of Status Resistance.

skills.name: Warrior's Vein
skills.description: Counter an attack. If successful, strike back with high damage and impact, and inflict Extreme Bleeding on yourself and the enemy.
skills.effects: = * Counter deals 2.0x Damage and 2.5x Impact. *Applies 100% buildup for Extreme Bleeding to both the player and the target. *The player won't get the status from this ability alone if they have any amount of Status Resistance.

skills.description: Grants Rage

skills.name: Evasion Shot

skills.effects: * Shoot while jumping backwards

skills.name: Hunter's Eye
skills.description: * The effect grants you double (2.0x) bow range. It has no effect on non-bow targeting range, however you can cast skills while locked with a bow.

skills.name: Sniper Shot

skills.effects: * Long-range sniper shot * Damage multiplier: 2.5x * Impact multiplier: 3.0x

skills.description: Boon effects increased

skills.effects: = * Requires at least 50% Corruption, and a Mana Stone * Consumes the Mana Stone and -30% Corruption to create a Dark Stone * Receive 65 Decay damage

skills.name: Lockwell's Revelation
skills.description: * Note: "elemental" refers to Ethereal, Decay, Lightning, Frost and Fire

skills.name: Rupture
skills.description: Detonate all Hexes on nearby enemies, and all souls, for related damage.
skills.effects: = Detonates all Hexes on all nearby Enemies for related effects. Removes Hexes from enemies (except Confusion), and consumes Revealed Souls. The detonations are AoE blasts, and the damage and impact of the blast depends on the Hex: * Chill: 50 Frost damage and 33 Impact * Curse: 50 Decay damage and 33 Impact * Doomed: 50 Lightning damage and 33 Impact * Haunted: 50 Ethereal damage and 33 Impact * Scorched: 50 Fire damage and 33 Impact * Pain: 50 Physical damage, 0 Impact * Confusion: 0 damage, 50 Impact

skills.name: Elemental Discharge
skills.description: Elemental projectile (varies)
skills.effects: Fires an elemental projectile at the targeted enemy, or straight ahead if not locked on. Depending on the current weapon imbue, Elemental Discharge produces different projectiles: Fire Imbues: * 60 damage * 60 impact Frost Imbues: * 60 damage * 60 impact Ethereal Imbues: * 60 damage * 60 impact Decay and Poison Imbues: * 60 damage * 60 impact Lightning and Light Imbues: * 60 damage * 60 impact Wind Imbues: * 30 damage * 140 impact

skills.name: Gong Strike
skills.description: Elemental explosion
skills.effects: Consumes the current weapon imbue to create a short-range but wide area of effect explosion of the consumed element. The damage and impact of the skill is based on the Shield stats, however any Effects on the shield are not applied here, they are only applied to Shield Charge. Depending on the current weapon imbue, Gong Strike produces different effects: Fire Imbues: * Damage overrides to Fire * Damage multiplier: 2.2x * Impact multiplier: 1.4x Frost Imbues: * Damage overrides to Frost * Damage multiplier: 2.2x * Impact multiplier: 1.4x Ethereal Imbues: * Damage overrides to Ethereal * Damage multiplier: 2.6x * Impact multiplier: 1.6x Decay Imbues: * Damage overrides to Decay * Damage multiplier: 2.6x * Impact multiplier: 1.6x Poison Imbues: * Damage overrides to Decay * Damage multiplier: 2.0x * Impact multiplier: 1.0x Lightning Imbues: * Damage overrides to Lightning * Damage multiplier: 2.3x * Impact multiplier: 1.9x Wind Imbues: * No damage * Guaranteed to knock all affected targets down (deals 99x impact)

skills.effects: * Fires an instant, long-range shot which deals 40 Decay damage, and applies equipped pistol's effects. If this instant shot hits: * Heals the caster for 40 health

skills.name: Marathoner
skills.description: Sprinting consumes 40% less Stamina.

skills.name: Shield Infusion
skills.description: Block an elemental attack; Shield Imbue
skills.effects: Activating this skill starts a blocking animation, during which you can block any type of attack (including magical blasts). If you block an attack which deals elemental (non- physical) damage during the animation, you gain a Shield Imbue of that element. In the case of multiple elements on one attack, the priority is first by which element dealt the most damage, but in the case of equal damage, the priority is then > > > > . When you have a Shield Imbue, the next blocked melee attack will create an area-of-effect explosion. The damage of the explosion is: * 1.3x equipped Shield damage as Ethereal damage * 2.0x equipped Shield damage as the element of the imbue (either ) * 2.0x equipped shield Impact damage See also: * Ethereal Shield Imbue * Decay Shield Imbue * Lightning Shield Imbue * Frost Shield Imbue * Fire Shield Imbue

skills.name: Chakram Dance
skills.description: Dodge backwards; Hits five times
skills.effects: * Hits five times in a several sweeping attacks * Impact is multiplied by 0.8x

skills.name: Fire Affinity
skills.description: Fire resistance +20%; Fire damage dealt +15%

skills.description: Creates a Sigil of Ice, enabling spell combos.

skills.name: Battle Rhythm
skills.description: Your deployed Sky Chimes increase Barrier by 5 and Ghost Drums increase Protection by 5 when within 8 meters. This bonus also applies to your allies
skills.effects: = When within 8 meters of an Instrument totem: * Haunting Beat increases Protection by 5 (through Ghost of Rhythm status) * Welkin Ring increases Barrier by 5 (through Sky Rhythm status) This effect also applies to allies and Summoned Ghost. {{SkillCombo | name = Welkin Rhythm | prereq = | action0 = | action1 = Battle Rhythm | action2 = Welkin Ring | effects = When within 8 meters of a Welkin Ring, the Sky Chimes increase Barrier by 5 }} {{SkillCombo | name = Ghost Rhythm | prereq = | action0 = | action1 = Battle Rhythm | action2 = Haunting Beat | effects = When within 8 meters of a Haunting Beat, the Ghost Drum increases Protection by 5 }}

skills.description: Allows you to have both a Sky Chimes totem and a Ghost Drums totem active in close proximity of each other at the same time.

skills.name: Nurturing Echo
skills.description: Generates a bubble around nearby Totems that provide restoration of some kind. Lasts longer depending on how many Charges the Totem has built up.
skills.effects: = The effect duration is determined by the number of Charges on the instrument, each charge grants 2 seconds to the duration with a maximum of 16 seconds (8 charges). * On Ghost Drum: Restores 5 Stamina and 5 Mana per second. * On Sky Chimes: Restores 5 Health and reduces buildup of status effects by 10% per second. {{SkillCombo | name = Nurturing Welkin Ring | prereq = | action0 = | action1 = Welkin Ring | action2 = Nurturing Echo | effects = Restores 5 Health and reduces buildup of status effects by 10% per second, for between 2 to 16 seconds depending on the number of charges. }} {{SkillCombo | name = Nurturing Ghost Drum | prereq = | action0 = | action1 = Haunting Beat | action2 = Nurturing Echo | effects = Restores 5 Stamina and 5 Mana per second, for between 2 to 16 seconds depending on the number of charges. }}

skills.name: Reverberation
skills.description: Recalls a deployed totem to your inventory, and generates a zone of recurring damage. The size, damage type and duration depend on the Totem and how many Charges it has built up.
skills.effects: = In all cases despite which totems it is and despite how charged they are: * An initial blast dealing 55 impact damage. With Haunting Beat, sends out pulses which deal Ethereal damage and 10 Impact once per second: * 0-3 Charges: Lasts 10 seconds, pulse deals 15 damage * 4-6 Charges: Lasts 15 seconds, pulse deals 15 damage * 7+ Charges: Lasts 15 seconds, pulse deals 25 damage With Welkin Ring, sends out pulses which deal Lightning damage and 10 Impact once per second: * 0-3 Charges: Lasts 10 seconds, pulse deals 15 damage * 4-6 Charges: Lasts 15 seconds, pulse deals 15 damage * 7+ Charges: Lasts 15 seconds, pulse deals 25 damage {{SkillCombo | name = Welkin Reverberation | prereq = | action0 = | action1 = Welkin Ring | action2 = Reverberation | effects = Recalls the Sky Chimes and creates a series of damaging pulses in their place.Pulses once per second for between 10 and 15 secondsPulses deal between 15 and 25 Lightning damage, 10 Impact }} {{SkillCombo | name = Ghost Reverberation | prereq = | action0 = | action1 = Haunting Beat | action2 = Reverberation | effects = Recalls the Ghost Drum and creates a series of damaging pulses in its place.Pulses once per second for between 10 and 15 secondsPulses deal between 15 and 25 Ethereal damage, 10 Impact }}

skills.name: Pressure Plate Expertise
skills.description: Increased Pressure Plate Trap power; Pressure Plate Traps are not consumed when triggered
skills.effects: All Pressure Plate traps can be re-used after being triggered, however the armed item is still destroyed. Bug 5/18/21 - Traps can still be destroyed on PS4 when using any trap. Higher chance of waste on Nerve Gas traps. Toxic Trap and Incendiary Trap: (same for "Improved" versions) * Add 30 Physical damage * Add 30 Impact Nerve Gas Trap: * Also inflicts Confusion Shock Trap: * Add 45 Lightning damage Flash Trap: * Add 30 Lightning damage Frost Trap: * Add 40 Frost damage Ethereal Trap: * Add 30 Ethereal damage Sapped Trap: * Adds 45 Lightning damage

skills.name: Serpent's Parry
skills.description: Counters attack; Confused targets are stunned; Targets with Pain receive Extreme Bleeding
skills.effects: * Successfully countering an attack and parrying will deal double damage and impact (2.0x) * Targets inflicted with Confusion will be stunned for 4 seconds * Targets inflicted with Pain will be inflicted with Extreme Bleeding

skills.name: Stealth Training
skills.description: Increased stealth
skills.effects: * Increases the player's Stealth (by about 30%). This is greater than the effects of Stealth Up. * Has a hidden effect of reducing the slow-down on movement speed when Crouching from -42.5% to -25%.

If you have a dagger in your off-hand while casting, you also gain the same Imbue on it. In the case of multiple elements on one attack, the priority is first by which element dealt the most damage, but in the case of equal damage, the priority is then > > > > . The Imbue and Boon that you receive depend on the first element in the priority order that you blocked: Fire: Frost: Lightning: Decay: Ethereal:

tiers.label: Tier 1 (Basic / Universal Skills)
tiers.mechanics: No restriction to buying them all. Usually costs 50 or 100 silver. Available from Teachers without learning the class Breakthrough.

tiers.label: Tier 2 (Breakthrough Skill)
tiers.mechanics: A Breakthrough Point is spent when learning these. Player has only 3 Breakthrough Points per character, and specialization choice is permanent. Required to access Tier 3 skills in that tree.

tiers.label: Tier 3 (Specialization / Advanced Skills)
tiers.mechanics: Can only be bought from a tree once you've unlocked that tree's Breakthrough skill. Paired skills (side by side in the tree) are mutually exclusive — choosing one locks out the other.
tiers.unlock_requirement: Requires Tier 2 (Breakthrough) in the same tree

tiers.label: Special / Quest / Trainer Skills
tiers.mechanics: Skills learned from Trainers (usually 50 silver), quest rewards, or faction-exclusive rewards. Not part of a class Breakthrough tree.
